---
title: "Download"
---

Files are served from the GitHub repository. Each file is an R object (`.rds`), so read it with `readRDS()`.

| File | Contents | Download |
|---|---|---|
| `kk-index-b-verified-network.rds` | definitions × sub-elements (`graph`, `biadjacency`) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/kkcc-two-mode-data/main/data/kk-index-b-verified-network.rds) |
| `kk-index-b-heading-network.rds` | definitions × headings (`graph`, `biadjacency`) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/kkcc-two-mode-data/main/data/kk-index-b-heading-network.rds) |
| `kk-index-b-work-concept-network-full.rds` | works × sub-elements (`two_mode_graph`), works × headings (`two_mode_heading_graph`), work table (`works`) | [download](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/kkcc-two-mode-data/main/data/kk-index-b-work-concept-network-full.rds) |

## Reading the files in R

```r
library(igraph)

u <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olizardo/kkcc-two-mode-data/main/data/kk-index-b-verified-network.rds"
net <- readRDS(gzcon(url(u)))
g <- net$graph
```

The works file contains three objects: `two_mode_graph`, `two_mode_heading_graph`, and `works`. Read it the same way and select the one you need.
